enrichment.headline: Adds $21,000 to Anthonio's inspections for Markham Elementary playmatting, extended to June 2022
enrichment.summary: Anthonio, Inc. will continue inspection services for the Markham Elementary School playmatting and accessibility project because several manufacturers could not deliver product on the original schedule. The contract maximum rises from $36,100 to $57,100 and the term is extended by 181 days, to June 30, 2022. It is paid from Measure J. The Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) this change.

enrichment.headline: Pays G & G Builders $179,890 to replace playstructure and playmatting at Hintil Kuu Child Development Center
enrichment.summary: G & G Builders, Inc. will remove old playstructures, repair asphalt with slurry seal, install a new playstructure and playmatting, and coordinate inspections at Hintil Kuu Child Development Center. enrichment.summary: Ninyo & Moore will keep sampling soil vapor and indoor and outdoor air each quarter at the Fremont High School new construction site, at the request of the California Department of Toxic Substances Control (DTSC).
